examples.arabic: قال طارق السلام عليكم مساء الخير
examples.english: Tariq said peace be upon you good evening
examples.transliteration: Qala Tariq as-salamu alaykum masa al-khayr

examples.arabic: قابل صديقه سامي وقال له السلام عليكم
examples.english: He met his friend Sami and said to him, "Peace be upon you."
examples.transliteration: Qabala sadiqa-hu Sami wa qala lahu As-salamu alaykum

examples.arabic: بعد الاجتماع، ودع يوسف: السلام عليكم، أراك مساءً.
examples.english: After the meeting, Youssef bid farewell: Peace be upon you, I will see you in the evening.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da al-ijtima', wadda'a Yusuf: As-salamu alaykum, araka masa'an.
examples.storyTitle: A Greeting at the Doha Museum

examples.arabic: اقترب منه قائلاً: "السلام عليكم يا أخي فؤاد، كيف حالك اليوم؟"
examples.english: He approached him saying: "Peace be upon you, my brother Fouad, how are you today?"
examples.transliteration: Iqtaraba minhu qa'ilan: "Al-salamu alaykum ya akhi Fouad, kayfa haluka al-yawm?"

examples.arabic: اذهب الى المدرسة والقي السلام على اصدقائي
examples.english: I go to school and greet my friends (say "peace be upon you").
examples.transliteration: Adhhab ila al-madrasah wa ulqi as-salam ala asdiqa'i.
